name: Research Pack
description: Search arXiv and Semantic Scholar, summarize papers faithfully, and produce verified citations, chained into a literature review.

agents.name: ArXiv Researcher
agents.description: Searches arXiv and Semantic Scholar for papers on a topic, ranks them by relevance and impact, and saves a clean shortlist with links and metadata.

agents.name: Paper Summarizer
agents.description: Reads research papers (PDF, text, or abstracts) from your working folder and writes structured, faithful summaries with methods, results, limitations and takeaways.

agents.name: Citation Formatter
agents.description: Turns DOIs, arXiv IDs, titles or messy reference lists into verified BibTeX, APA 7 and MLA 9 citations, using Crossref and arXiv metadata.
